startCountdown.description: Starts the countdown, should be used after finishing your Pre-Song Cutscene.

endSong.description: Ends the song, can be cancelled through the Lua/HScript callback 'onEndSong' to make cutscenes.

getSongPosition.description: Returns the current song position, in milliseconds.

restartSong.description: Restarts the Song, pretty self explanatory.

parameters.skipTransition: Skips fade in/out transition, defaults to false.

examples: Restarts the song with fade transition.
Restarts the song without fade transition.

exitSong.description: Quits the Song and goes back to Freeplay/Story Mode based on where you started.

loadSong.description: Loads the chart for a song.

parameters.name: Song Name (ex. "Bopeebo", "Lit Up"), use null to keep current.
parameters.difficultyNum: Week's Difficulty Number (0 = Easy, 1 = Normal, 2 = Hard), use -1 to keep it the same as current.

examples: Loads Lit Up on Normal difficulty.

triggerEvent.description: Calls an event and uses two arguments for it, exactly like the Chart Editor does. Should always return 'true'.

parameters.name: Event Name.
parameters.value1: Does the same as what the Event says in the Chart Editor.
parameters.value2: Does the same as what the Event says in the Chart Editor.

examples: Calls "Hey!" event with BF as value1 and 0.6 as value2.

setHealthBarColors.description: Changes Health Bar colors using hexadecimal or color names.

parameters.left: Color hexadecimal string or color name for the left side of the bar.
parameters.right: Color hexadecimal string or color name for the right side of the bar.

examples: Makes left side red and right side lime.
Same as above, but using color names.

startDialogue.description: Loads a Dialogue .JSON inside the Chart folder, handles translation loading automatically.

parameters.music: Plays a background music inside 'music/' folder.

examples: Loads "dialogue.json" inside the chart folder, will prefer "dialogue_pt-BR.json" if you're playing on Portuguese (Brazil).
Same as above, but plays "Breakfast" as background music.

parameters.videoFile: Video .MP4 file located inside 'videos/' folder, don't include the extension!
parameters.canSkip: Allows the video to be skipped by holding down Enter for a second. Defaults to true.
parameters.forMidSong: Doesn't start/finish song after the video ends, needed for mid-song cutscenes. Defaults to false.
parameters.shouldLoop: Video will repeat once finished. Defaults to false.
parameters.playOnLoad: Videos plays instantly after loading. Defaults to true.
